Three exercises on getting the functional form right. Belongs to [Multiple regression](../topics/40-multiple-regression.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae06-multiple-regression-part-3.zip" download>⬇ Download ae06-multiple-regression-part-3.zip</a></p>
```

:::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio. Every path inside the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
::::
